posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
MarioFanaticXV:

Seems kind of silly to run the preorders for only one month… But I really want to get those promo cards, so I plan to order before the game releases. I've been really looking forward to this, but I just now found out they did this pre-pre-order run (why? Why not just wait until you're ready to take preorders in full?).

 

Don't think there will be any other pre-orders. Since there wasn't a Kickstarter, GtG ran this pre-order as a special opportunity for the same length of time as a Kickstarter. They have to put a limit on the time of this special pre-order because they need to know how many of the promo cards to print. If you missed the opportunity to get these promo cards, you'll have an opportunity to get them at some upcoming conventions, you will probably be able to print them yourself eventually, and you will be able to get them as part of a collection of all promo cards that will be made available at some point after all of the Sentinels expansions are released in the next few years.

 

Are  any of those other options as ideal as being able to get the promos now? No, probably not, but there it is.

posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
theres an awful temptation to feel like its some kind of personal attack when something cool happens and you don't find out about it until too late. And you've got some legitimate points about the news section on SoTM and the mailing list.  

They allowed people to pre-order vengeance (with promo cards) through the shattered timelines kickstarter.  You opted not participate, which was either a conscious decision, or you hadn't come to the game at that point.  If its the latter, then I'm certainly not going to begrudge your desire to get in on the action.

They allowed people who could not participate in the kickstarter to pre-order vengeance for a month on this site (with promo cards), which they advertised through the forums, facebook, twitter, Board game geek and the GtG website- albeit the newer version that they switched to about a year ago.  I can understand your annoyance about the mailing list and SoTM news section, and hopefully it will be rectified soon.

You'll still have the chance to pick up vengeance in february (or whenever it comes out), with a minimal delay between when kickstarter backers/per-order backers get it, and when it becomes commercially available.  Indeed, they've pointed out that everyone will get their copies about the same time. 

As for the promo cards, within a few days of release, high-res scans will become available on BGG for you to print, just like all the other promo cards.

If thats still not satisfactory, they are available at conventions, for the cost of playing a few games of Sentinels and getting Sentinel points to trade in.

If that isn't satisfactory, you could always ask (politely) on the forums if someone going to a convention could pick you up a copy of the Greatest Legacy and GI bunker promo card and mail it to you afterwards.  You might have to work out a trade, or just be persuasive and hope for someone on the forums to be awesome...and there are a lot of awesome people here who understand the lure of Promo cards, play a LOT of sentinels at conventions, and might be willing.

EDIT:

Braithwhite:

theres an awful temptation to feel like its some kind of personal attack when something cool happens and you don't find out about it until too late. And you've got some legitimate points about the news section on SoTM and the mailing list.

My appologies if I made it sound like I was under the delusion that this was some crazy conspiracy to exclude me personally, that certainly wasn't my intent.

They allowed people to pre-order vengeance (with promo cards) through the shattered timelines kickstarter.  You opted not participate, which was either a conscious decision, or you hadn't come to the game at that point.  If its the latter, then I'm certainly not going to begrudge your desire to get in on the action.

Shattered Timelines was already out by time I got into Sentinels; I essentially bought the entire collection up to that point in May, though it was a joint purchase- I bought half of it, and my family bought the other half for my birthday at the end of June.

They allowed people who could not participate in the kickstarter to pre-order vengeance for a month on this site (with promo cards), which they advertised through the forums, facebook, twitter, Board game geek and the GtG website- albeit the newer version that they switched to about a year ago.  I can understand your annoyance about the mailing list and SoTM news section, and hopefully it will be rectified soon.

I don't use Facebook or Twitter; as for the forums, I usually got to BGG for forums, though admittedly most of my time on BGG lately has bee spent on the Descent boards. I haven't had many questions about SotM lately, just questions about Vengeance, which I figured I'd be able to find out via the mailing list anyways.

You'll still have the chance to pick up vengeance in february (or whenever it comes out), with a minimal delay between when kickstarter backers/per-order backers get it, and when it becomes commercially available.  Indeed, they've pointed out that everyone will get their copies about the same time.

But will other preorders include the promo cards that have been teased at us for so long? I'd gladly preorder from Cool Stuff Inc. right now if it were guaranteed to have the preorder bonuses. Otherwise, I might as well wait until after Christmas and I've done all my Christmas shopping (which indeed was what I was hoping to do since

As for the promo cards, within a few days of release, high-res scans will become available on BGG for you to print, just like all the other promo cards.

I've done this with the other promo cards (save for the villain cards, since they rereleased those with the Oversized Villain Card pack), but I was really looking forward to getting the real thing with these. It's something they've promised for so long, then they didn't make good on that promise save to a few people in private circles.

If thats still not satisfactory, they are available at conventions, for the cost of playing a few games of Sentinels and getting Sentinel points to trade in.

As much as I'd love to go to a convention, then I have to factor in things like airfare, the cost of the convention itself… It's not like these things are exactly common, and certainly not cheap either. It seems kind of outlandish for them to expect fans to have to go to specific locations at very specific dates to get a slim chance at getting them. Why not just include them with all preorders?

If that isn't satisfactory, you could always ask (politely) on the forums if someone going to a convention could pick you up a copy of the Greatest Legacy and GI bunker promo card and mail it to you afterwards.  You might have to work out a trade, or just be persuasive and hope for someone on the forums to be awesome…and there are a lot of awesome people here who understand the lure of Promo cards, play a LOT of sentinels at conventions, and might be willing.

But then I'd feel like they were making a sacrifice for me, which is something I generally try to avoid asking of random strangers. Friends I don't mind asking for gifts, but that's because I know that even if I'm not directly trading them something for it, I'll probably make it up to them some way in the future. Besides that, if party A wrongs party B, I feel it's wrong to punish party C who had no involvement in the matter.
